en.headline: Customs seize 2.2kg suspected cocaine at airport, charge mainland man
en.dek: A 39-year-old passenger from Penang was arrested after officers found the drugs in his carry-on baggage, and he will appear in court tomorrow.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected a drug trafficking case at Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday involving an incoming passenger from Penang, Malaysia.

Officers seized about 2.2 kilograms of suspected cocaine with an estimated market value of about HK$1.3 million from the carry-on baggage of a 39-year-old Mainland man during clearance. He was arrested and has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug.

The case will be brought up at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Court on Monday. Customs said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement against transnational drug trafficking and urged the public not to participate in such activities for monetary return or to carry unknown items for others.
Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, the maximum penalty upon conviction for trafficking in a dangerous drug is a fine of HK$5 million and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲2.2公斤懷疑可卡因 拘捕內地漢
zh.dek: 一名39歲從檳城抵港的男乘客手提行李藏毒被捕，已遭控以販運危險藥物，周一提堂。
body: 香港海關周日在香港國際機場偵破一宗入境旅客販毒案，涉案者從馬來西亞檳城抵港。
海關人員在一名39歲內地男子的手提行李中檢獲約2.2公斤懷疑可卡因，估計市值約130萬港元，隨即將他拘捕。該男子已遭控以一項販運危險藥物罪。
案件將於周一在西九龍裁判法院提堂。海關表示會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊跨境販毒活動，並提醒市民切勿為金錢參與販毒，亦勿代人攜帶來歷不明物品。
根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物一經定罪，最高可判罰款500萬港元及終身監禁。
